events.title: The Unending Footnote
events.context: A footnote references itself and seems to be getting longer by the minute.

options.label: Summarize the note
options.consequence: You seal the loop with a clear summary; the archivists can finally stop rereading it.

options.label: Trace its earliest reference
options.consequence: The earliest reference seems to predate the manuscript by a century.

options.label: Archive a safe copy
options.consequence: Your copy gives the guild a stable version for its records.

events.title: The Sealed Chamber
events.context: Damaged sigils cover the entrance of a narrow chamber.

options.label: Repair the seal
options.consequence: The damaged sigil holds long enough to let the party pass safely.

options.label: Read the surviving marks
options.consequence: The oldest marks reveal the chamber was sealed from the inside.

options.label: Mark a safe route
options.consequence: Your route markers help the guild reconstruct the chamber layout.

events.title: The Absent Librarian
events.context: An empty chair keeps turning pages in a book.

options.label: Study the book
options.consequence: The pages describe a quiet visitor who never signed the lending book.

options.label: Follow the page numbers
options.consequence: The repeating page numbers form a short numerical clue.

options.label: Write down the pattern
options.consequence: A precise transcription becomes part of the shared investigation.

events.title: The Singing Ledger
events.context: A merchant ledger hums whenever two numbers match.

options.label: Balance its entries
options.consequence: You reconcile the figures, and the ledger hums a satisfied chord.

options.label: Study the tune
options.consequence: The tune matches a melody in an old festival account.

options.label: Copy the unusual totals
options.consequence: The odd totals reveal a pattern others can investigate.

events.title: The Wrong-Way Map
events.context: A map points north no matter how it is turned.

options.label: Trust the compass
options.consequence: The compass route leads to a safe crossing.

options.label: Compare another map
options.consequence: Another map reveals a vanished bridge in the same place.

options.label: Trace hidden ink
options.consequence: The hidden ink traces a path that can be added to the guild chart.

events.title: The Vanished Seal
events.context: The royal wax seal has faded, leaving behind a warm imprint.

options.label: Restore the imprint
options.consequence: A careful repair leaves the shape of the royal seal intact.

options.label: Identify the wax
options.consequence: The wax contains an unfamiliar mineral that may identify its origin.

options.label: Describe the original design
options.consequence: Your sketch lets the guild compare it with other seals.

events.title: The Mirrored Archive
events.context: An inscription reads differently in each polished surface.

options.label: Decode the reflection
options.consequence: One reflection shows a word missing from every ordinary copy.

options.label: Test a second mirror
options.consequence: The second mirror reveals an older spelling of the inscription.

options.label: Take a careful rubbing
options.consequence: Your rubbing preserves the script for future researchers.

events.title: The Gentle Correction
events.context: A manuscript corrects a spelling mistake whenever you look away.

options.label: Accept the edit
options.consequence: You accept the correction and preserve the text in its clearest form.

options.label: Inspect the margin
options.consequence: A pencil mark in the margin suggests the page knows its previous readers.

options.label: Record both versions
options.consequence: Your comparison of both versions helps establish the revision order.

events.title: The Warm Inkwell
events.context: A bottle of ink seems warm, even though the room is cold.

options.label: Seal the bottle
options.consequence: The warmed bottle is safely contained without spilling its contents.

options.label: Test a single drop
options.consequence: One drop spells a place name before vanishing.

options.label: Copy its label
options.consequence: The label provides a maker's mark for the guild registry.

events.title: The List of Lists
events.context: A catalog contains an index to every catalog except itself.

options.label: Add the missing entry
options.consequence: Your new entry completes the catalog without contradiction.

options.label: Research the omission
options.consequence: The missing catalog seems to have been hidden deliberately.

options.label: Create a cross-reference
options.consequence: A clear cross-reference helps every future scholar navigate the list.

events.title: Pages by Moonlight
events.context: Faint writing becomes visible only beneath a silver lamp.

options.label: Read slowly
options.consequence: Slow reading reveals a complete sentence beneath the silver light.

options.label: Compare with another page
options.consequence: The neighboring page uses a different date for the same event.

options.label: Sketch the glyphs
options.consequence: Your glyph sketch helps the guild preserve the fragile text.

events.title: The Polite Door
events.context: A door apologizes each time someone tries to open it.

options.label: Fix the hinge
options.consequence: After a small adjustment, the door opens and thanks you politely.

options.label: Ask what happened
options.consequence: The door remembers a traveler whose name has vanished from records.

options.label: Search for another entrance
options.consequence: The alternate route gives the party a reliable way forward.

events.title: A Rain of Paper
events.context: A tiny storm of paper circles a deserted reading table.

options.label: Calm the magic
options.consequence: You settle the paper storm and keep the pages from tearing.

options.label: Read a falling page
options.consequence: One falling page contains a line the Chronicle no longer remembers.

options.label: Gather loose fragments
options.consequence: Your recovered fragments can be organized by the guild.

events.title: The Silent Bell
events.context: An ancient bell moves but makes no sound.

options.label: Read its inscription
options.consequence: The inscription identifies the bell as a warning for forgotten stories.

options.label: Test the clapper
options.consequence: The clapper is intact; the silence is magical rather than mechanical.

options.label: Record the silence
options.consequence: Your notes add a new clue to the guild's records.

events.title: The Midnight Draft
events.context: A draft of the Chronicle is dated tomorrow.

options.label: Compare its text
options.consequence: You compare the draft line by line and find a safe copy of the passage.

options.label: Investigate the date
options.consequence: The date is written in a calendar used before the current king.

options.label: Preserve an exact copy
options.consequence: An exact duplicate gives the guild a reliable future reference.

events.title: The Hidden Stair
events.context: A worn book spine reveals the outline of a secret staircase.

options.label: Open the passage
options.consequence: The stairs open into an undisturbed passage of old stone.

options.label: Map the steps
options.consequence: Your map shows that the stairs bend around an empty room.

options.label: Look for another clue
options.consequence: A second clue points toward a shelf marked with a faded crest.

events.title: The Stubborn Quill
events.context: A quill refuses to write a particular name.

options.label: Try another name
options.consequence: A different name makes the quill begin writing normally again.

options.label: Study the ink
options.consequence: The ink fades when the missing name is spoken aloud.

options.label: Document the refusal
options.consequence: Your careful report identifies the forbidden name's first appearance.

events.title: The Backward Hourglass
events.context: Sand rises inside an old hourglass.

options.label: Repair the glass
options.consequence: The hourglass works normally after its cracked frame is secured.

options.label: Measure the sand
options.consequence: The rising sand reveals a hidden engraving on the glass.

options.label: Trace its maker mark
options.consequence: The maker's mark links the hourglass to an old royal workshop.

events.title: The Forgotten Key
events.context: A key opens a drawer that is no longer there.

options.label: Study the lock
options.consequence: The matching lock was removed long ago, but its outline remains.

options.label: Find the matching drawer
options.consequence: A drawer in the neighboring room fits the key exactly.

options.label: Copy the key shape
options.consequence: A sketch of the key helps identify a missing cabinet.

events.title: A Borrowed Memory
events.context: A page describes a festival none of the villagers remember.

options.label: Interview a witness
options.consequence: A witness remembers music, though not the festival itself.

options.label: Search old records
options.consequence: Old ledgers show the festival took place on a date the Chronicle omits.

options.label: Preserve the account
options.consequence: A preserved account helps the guild restore the celebration's history.

events.title: The Tower in the Margin
events.context: A marginal note mentions a tower absent from every map.

options.label: Follow the reference
options.consequence: The reference leads to a real tower foundation concealed by vines.

options.label: Compare versions
options.consequence: An earlier manuscript contains a map that still shows the tower.

options.label: Add a cautious note
options.consequence: A careful margin note lets the guild connect both records.

events.title: The Ink Bridge
events.context: A puddle of ink briefly forms the shape of a stone bridge.

options.label: Stabilize the image
options.consequence: The ink bridge holds its shape long enough to be measured.

options.label: Study its reflection
options.consequence: The reflection reveals an inscription beneath the imagined arch.

options.label: Record its arch pattern
options.consequence: Your arch drawing allows the guild to compare an old stone bridge.

events.title: The Silver Latch
events.context: A silver latch turns only while a sentence is read aloud.

options.label: Read the inscription
options.consequence: The latch opens gently when the line is read in its original order.

options.label: Inspect the latch
options.consequence: A maker's mark on the latch suggests a forgotten restoration school.

options.label: Note the exact words
options.consequence: Your exact transcription helps others repeat the opening spell.

events.title: The Last Annotation
events.context: The final annotation is signed with a name nobody recognizes.

options.label: Trace the signature
options.consequence: The signature is copied safely before its ink begins to disappear.

options.label: Compare handwriting
options.consequence: A handwriting match points to the unnamed historian's own papers.

options.label: Preserve the evidence
options.consequence: The preserved signature becomes a lasting clue for the guild.

chapters.title: The Missing Pages
chapters.intro: The pages of the Royal Chronicle are disappearing, yet its numbering is perfect.
chapters.recap: The guild restores the first fragments and discovers a signature belonging to a forgotten historian.

scenes.text: The Royal Chronicle has lost three pages. Stranger still, the librarian says nobody remembers what they contained.
A page recovered from a nearby library describes a royal procession no living witness can recall. Its number fits perfectly in the Chronicle.
Another expedition returns with a margin note: If the record is corrected, who will remember the first version?
A name appears on the fragments, then fades. The guild resolves to find the historian who signed them.

chapters.title: The Forgotten Author
chapters.intro: Three drafts disagree about a historian whose name has been erased from memory.
chapters.recap: A hidden instruction is recovered: Seek the version before the first revision.

scenes.text: The lost historian left behind three versions of the same history, each contradicting the others.
The first draft mentions a tower the kingdom no longer remembers.
The second draft erases the tower but preserves an impossible date in its margin.
The third draft contains only a single instruction: Seek the version before the first revision.
The guild can now search for the original Chronicle - and begin to ask why it was changed.

chapters.title: The Forbidden Revision
chapters.intro: An earlier draft suggests someone edited memories to prevent a disaster.

chapters.title: The Final Draft
chapters.intro: The guild must decide how to preserve history without repeating old mistakes.
